# Justin Farajollah

> Justin Farajollah builds websites for small businesses.

Justin is a student at Indiana University's Kelley School of Business. He designs, builds and launches websites for small businesses, and also takes on smaller one-off projects such as SEO, AI search optimization and logo design.

## Pages

- [Home](https://justinfarajollah.com/): Who Justin is, his recent work, what he does and how a project works
- [Contact](https://justinfarajollah.com/contact): Book a chat, send a text or write an email

## Recent work

- [Dr. Brianna Olamiju](https://docbrianna.com): Website for a medical and cosmetic dermatologist
- [Eagle Point Coaching](https://eaglepointcoaching.co): Website for an executive coaching practice
- [Ultimate AVI](https://ultimateavi.net): Website for a smart home and AV integrator
